title: Focus huddle ledger — Omar Farouk (prep & follow ups)
content:
Purpose:
Quick, tactical prep for my weekly focused huddle with Omar. This is a lightweight ledger — checkpoints, hypotheses, and concrete follow-ups. Use during the meeting, then convert action items to Jira and add timelines.

Context snapshot (for quick read):
- Omar: Senior SW Eng on serving-runtime, owning the KV cache project and model-variant routing prototype.
- Recent: KV cache perf regression (p95 latency +80ms week-over-week); canary rollout paused.
- Goal for this cycle: stabilize p95 <= 120ms for common tails, unblock canary, plan medium-term refactor for cache sharding.

Agenda (30m total)
- 0–5m: Quick mental load check + calendar constraints.
- 5–12m: Data deep dive — recent perf shifts, immediate suspects. (Ravi aggregated metrics)
- 12–20m: Root-cause hypotheses & quick experiments (what to try this sprint).
- 20–26m: Career/shape conversation — where Omar wants to stretch next quarter.
- 26–30m: Commit actions, owners, dates. Check for blockers across teams.

Key data points to reference:
- Canary cluster p95: 210ms (peak spike May 2–4), baseline previously 125ms.
- Error ratio on canary: 0.6% (http 500s during heavy prefix cache misses).
- Recent PRs hitting runtime: #412 (kv-cache opt), #418 (route-batching).
- SLA target: p95 < 150ms (internal customer SLO = 120ms).

Hypotheses (short bullets)
- H1: A new kernel selection fallback introduced an unoptimized path for short sequences.
- H2: The canary traffic distribution is skewed to long-context tests that bypass cache (test config mismatch).
- H3: Contention in the LRU eviction logic under bursty traffic causing stalls.

Questions to ask Omar (notes-to-self style)
- Which PRs landed in the window right before the spike? Any hotfixes reversed?
- Did the canary traffic generator change seed or distribution? (If yes, re-run with old seed)
- Are there any infra alerts correlating with GC or host saturation? (ask SRE for node-level metrics)
- Which hypothesis would be the fastest to validate in under a day? (prefer load test + profile)

Manager nudges / tone reminders
- Keep it collaborative — we need Omar’s read on code-level tradeoffs, not a firefight.
- If he looks defensive, switch to pairing on a micro-experiment.
- Validate confidence numerically — ask for an experiment plan with measurable success criteria.

Draft micro-experiments (quick, 1–3 day turnarounds)
- EXP-A: Revert kernel fallback in canary for 2 hours, measure p95. (Owner: Omar)
- EXP-B: Re-run canary with previous traffic seed + compare cache hit ratio. (Owner: SRE / Omar)
- EXP-C: Add fine-grained tracing around LRU eviction for 2k requests, sample traces. (Owner: Omar + Observability)

Action items (we will convert to Jira tickets after the call):
- AI-1: Omar — post a short experiment plan for EXP-A by EOD today and start a 2h revert window tomorrow morning. Due: 2027-05-09.
- AI-2: Ravi — provide node-level metric slice (CPU, IO wait, GC) for canary hosts between May 1–6. Due: 2027-05-09.
- AI-3: Asha (me) — set up a paired session Wed to help script the eviction tracer and review traces. Due: 2027-05-11.
- AI-4: Observability team (cc): Enable LRU eviction sampling for the canary pool for the next 48h. Due: 2027-05-09.
- AI-5: Omar — propose a candidate timeline for KV cache sharding design doc (first draft) by next Tuesday 2027-05-14.

Career/Growth quick notes (10–15m block)
- Omar expressed interest in owning a cross-team initiative (infra + runtime) — see if we can craft a scoped project (sharding pilot) as a leadership opportunity.
- Coach points: practice concise status narratives; encourage him to lead a 15m sync with SRE to reduce cross-team friction.

Risks / blockers to call out
- If EXP-A reversion is blocked by compliance gating on canary images, escalate to Release Eng.
- Observability backlog may delay trace sampling; have an interim plan (local profiler capture).

Post-meeting follow-ups (my checklist)
- Move AI items into Jira with owners + acceptance criteria (today).
- Book 1h pairing slot Wed for trace work.
- Email SRE + Observability a short context note linking to AI items and ask for SLAs on enabling sampling.
- Follow up on career ask: draft a pilot charter and run by product manager for scoping.

Loose notes / stream-of-consciousness (for capture)
- Omar seems more energized when we focus on tangible experiments rather than abstract design. Keep the conversation anchored.
- Consider rotating a weekly "quick smoke" across canary configs so we don't get surprised by distribution drift.
- Might be worth a short postmortem doc if EXP-A shows clear regression cause — keep notes for that.

References / quick links to paste in meeting chat:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/412
- Perf dashboard (canary): https://internal.redwood/perf/canary/kv-cache
- Jira epic: JIRA-2281

End ledger. After meeting: convert to tidy notes and create Jira tasks.
